basics.name: Shoib Ahmad
basics.label: Full-Stack Engineer | React · Next.js · REST APIs · AI/LLM Integration · Tailwind
basics.summary: Final-year MCA student (CGPA 8.10) who ships production fullstack systems end-to-end — from React/Next.js interfaces to REST API backends — including a live examination-integrity platform in daily institutional use and an offline-first rural healthcare platform, both owned solo from requirements through deployment. Comfortable across the stack (React.js, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI/Django REST Framework), with a track record of turning ambiguous product requirements into working, well-tested systems with minimal supervision. Integrates LLMs (Gemini, Claude) into real product workflows — prompt design, model evaluation, pipeline integration — and is currently deepening TypeScript and Node.js/NestJS.

work.name: Mike Agent AI
work.summary: Building agentic AI workflows: multi-step tool use, orchestration, and evaluation of model behaviour in production paths.

work.name: SecureEval AI
highlights: Architected and delivered a dual-interface fullstack examination-integrity platform (React.js frontend, FastAPI backend), now live and in active daily use — owned end-to-end from design through deployment.
Designed high-throughput asynchronous REST API endpoints with clear service contracts to reliably handle concurrent student sessions at scale.
Integrated MediaPipe Face Mesh and Gemini 1.5 for real-time multi-face detection and behavioral analysis, achieving 90%+ suspicious-activity detection precision.
Partnered directly with university stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements into a reliable, observable system with a real-time admin monitoring dashboard.

work.name: RuralHealthAI
highlights: Independently designed and built RuralHealthAI, an offline-capable disease-screening platform (Django REST Framework backend, React 18/Vite frontend) for frontline rural health workers, delivered as a client engagement.
Architected a local-first offline sync layer using IndexedDB and a custom SyncQueue handling retry logic, conflict resolution, and automatic reconciliation on reconnect.

Integrated Google Gemini Pro for AI-driven clinical risk analysis and built REST endpoints for authentication, role-based dashboards, and screening data (Firebase Auth/Firestore + PostgreSQL audit logging).
Implemented role-based access across health worker, officer, and patient interfaces, including a regional dashboard for high-risk surveillance and analytics.

projects.name: Web Sonar — Web Intelligence Engine
highlights: Built a scalable Python data pipeline (FastAPI, Scrapy, Playwright) across 50+ dynamic sources, achieving a 98% retrieval success rate at 10,000+ daily requests.
Engineered 24 analyzer modules across 30+ analysis panels, integrating the Gemini API to extract structured insights from web data at scale.

projects.name: TruthGuard AI — Deepfake Detection System
highlights: Engineered a CNN-based deep learning model (PyTorch, OpenCV) achieving 92% accuracy on the FaceForensics++ benchmark, served through a tested FastAPI REST service with a live analytics dashboard.

projects.name: Med-AI Vigi — Adverse Drug Reaction Risk Predictor
highlights: Trained an XGBoost/Random Forest ensemble achieving an 87% F1-score, reducing false-negative rates by 18% over baseline.
